operation.description: Sync a branch of a forked repository to keep it up-to-date with the upstream repository.

branch.description: The name of the branch which should be updated to match upstream.

200.description: The branch has been successfully synced with the upstream repository

409.description: The branch could not be synced because of a merge conflict

422.description: The branch could not be synced for some other reason

operation.summary: Sync a fork branch with the upstream repository
